description: Complete knowledge base management - create, maintain, query, and visualize a local Markdown knowledge base across 13 page types (source, topic, concept, decision, query, synthesis, entity, pattern, runbook, architecture, guide, reference, example) with RAG compatibility, validation, deduplication, and cross-linking

evals.prompt: Create a knowledge note about incident response for SRE
evals.expected_output: Creates wiki/runbooks/incident-response.md with valid frontmatter, type=runbook, proper structure

assertions.evidence: id, type, domain, tags, summary present

evals.prompt: Document a pattern for blue-green deployment in kubernetes
evals.expected_output: Creates wiki/patterns/blue-green-deployment.md with type=pattern, problem/solution structure

evals.prompt: Create a concept note explaining service mesh architecture
Document a microservices architecture for e-commerce
evals.expected_output: Creates wiki/architectures/ecommerce.md with type=architecture, components, data flow

assertions.evidence: Has Overview, Components, Data Flow, Observability

evals.prompt: Create knowledge note but check for duplicates first
evals.expected_output: Searches existing wiki pages, reports if similar exists

assertions.evidence: Script or search executed before creation

evals.expected_output: Creates wiki/concepts/docker.md with folder structure (concepts/guides/references/examples), proper frontmatter, all sections, and INDEX.md

evals.prompt: Find duplicates in my knowledge base
evals.expected_output: Scans wiki/**/*.md, produces duplicate report grouped by HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW similarity, suggests actions

evals.prompt: Document how to set up CI/CD pipeline
evals.expected_output: Creates wiki/guides/ci-cd-pipeline.md with guide type, folder structure, proper frontmatter

evals.prompt: Clean up overlapping notes about microservices
evals.expected_output: Identifies similar notes, proposes merge or link actions, NEVER auto-deletes

evals.prompt: Check for duplicates using the deduplicate script
evals.expected_output: Runs skills/migraph/scripts/deduplicate.py, outputs JSON report with similarity scores

assertions.evidence: Each pair has title_score, content_score, tag_score

evals.prompt: Run deduplicate on wiki/ and save report
evals.expected_output: Generates duplicate_report.md with HIGH/MEDIUM sections and recommendations

evals.prompt: Create a quick reference for kubectl commands
evals.expected_output: Creates wiki/references/kubectl.md with type=reference, quick reference table

evals.prompt: Create an example for terraform from official docs
evals.expected_output: Creates wiki/examples/terraform-example.md with type=example, fetched from official documentation
